hotel.name: Quality Inn & Suites Denver International Airport

activities.title: WN #3914 Departs STL Lambert
activities.description: 2h 20m flight to Denver. Land 11:55PM.
activities.address: Lambert-St. Louis International Airport, St. Louis, MO 63145

activities.title: Rental Car Pickup at DEN
activities.description: Pick up full-size SUV at DEN on-airport facility. Book in advance. Drive 10 min to hotel.

activities.title: Check Into Quality Inn & Suites Denver Airport
activities.description: Sleep. Early checkout tomorrow 7:00 AM for Pikes Peak drive.

days.title: Colorado Springs — Pikes Peak + Garden of Gods

hotel.name: The Academy Hotel Colorado Springs
hotel.address: 8110 N Academy Blvd, Colorado Springs, CO 80920
hotel.notes: Free made-to-order breakfast. Indoor pool. Request upper floor. 20-30 min to Cog Railway.

activities.title: Depart Hotel — Drive to Manitou Springs
activities.description: Leave by 7AM sharp. 1 hr 15 min drive to Cog Railway depot. Must arrive by 8:30AM for 9AM train.

activities.title: Pikes Peak Cog Railway
activities.description: Board 9AM train. Sit on LEFT side going up (A/B/C seats) for best panoramic views. 40 min at summit (14,115 ft). Buy famous cinnamon donuts at summit. Photos first — gift shop last. Back at depot by 1:30PM.
tips: Book 2 weeks minimum in advance — sells out
Sit LEFT side going up for best views
Bring layers — summit is 30°F cooler than base
Photos first, donuts second, gift shop last

flag.text: Afternoon thunderstorms common at summit. Morning train is essential.

activities.title: Garden of the Gods
activities.description: Free entry. Scenic loop drive 30-45 min. Perkins Central Garden Trail (1.5 mi easy, 45 min). Siamese Twins Trail adds geological arch views. Allow 2.5 hrs total.

activities.title: Red Rock Canyon Open Space
activities.description: Same red sandstone formations as Garden of Gods but without tourist crowds. Mesa Trail (easy, 1.5 mi). Views back toward Garden of Gods. Local favorite — genuinely underrated.
activities.address: 3550 W High St, Colorado Springs, CO 80904

activities.title: Check Into Academy Hotel
activities.description: Indoor pool for your daughter. Arcade. Dinner options on-site or nearby.
activities.address: 8110 N Academy Blvd, Colorado Springs, CO 80920

days.title: Colorado Springs → Buena Vista → Twin Lakes → Glenwood Springs

driveFromPrevious.via: Hwy 24 W → Hwy 285 N → Hwy 24 W → I-70 W

hotel.name: Residence Inn by Marriott Glenwood Springs
hotel.notes: All-suite with full kitchenettes. Free daily breakfast. Indoor heated pool + hot tub. Local bus to Aspen directly behind hotel. Parking $12/day.

activities.title: Checkout & Depart Colorado Springs — Scenic Drive via Buena Vista
activities.description: Late checkout — no rush this morning. Head west on Hwy 24 through Colorado's most dramatic mountain pass country. The route via Buena Vista and Twin Lakes is far more scenic than I-70 and only marginally longer. You'll pass the Collegiate Peaks (Harvard, Yale, Oxford, Columbia — all 14ers). About 2 hrs to Buena Vista.

driveInfo.via: Hwy 24 W → Buena Vista → Twin Lakes → Independence Pass or Hwy 82 → Glenwood

activities.title: Buena Vista — Lunch Stop
activities.description: Charming mountain town on the Arkansas River — perfect spot to stop for lunch and stretch your legs. Eddyline Brewery and Deerhammer both have solid food menus, or grab a table on Main Street with views of the Collegiate Peaks. About an hour here, then push on toward Twin Lakes.

activities.title: Twin Lakes — Photo Stop
activities.description: Two stunning glacial lakes at the base of Mount Elbert (Colorado's highest peak at 14,440 ft). The reflection of the mountains in the lake is iconic. Short walk along the lake shore. 20-30 min stop. This is genuinely one of Colorado's most photogenic spots.
tips: Drive to the east end of the lake for best mountain reflection shots
Your daughter will love the flat pebble beach for skipping stones

flag.text: Independence Pass (12,095 ft, Hwy 82) is the most spectacular but CLOSED to vehicles over 35 ft and may have snow in early June — check cotrip.org morning of Jun 21.

activities.via: Hwy 82 W (or Hwy 24 + I-70 if pass closed)

activities.title: Check Into Residence Inn Glenwood Springs
activities.description: Check in, unpack. Full kitchen — settle in. You're here 2 nights.

activities.title: Two Rivers Park — Evening Walk
activities.description: Confluence of the Colorado and Roaring Fork Rivers. Paved walking trail, footbridge with mountain views, picnic areas. Free and flat. Your daughter can wade in the river shallows.

days.title: Maroon Bells + Downtown Aspen + Silver Queen Gondola

hotel.name: Residence Inn by Marriott Glenwood Springs

activities.title: Depart Glenwood — Drive to Aspen Highlands
activities.description: Leave by 7AM. 30 miles via Hwy 82. Arrive Welcome Center by 7:45AM. Park in garage ($40 max for the day). Board 8AM shuttle.

activities.title: Maroon Bells — Round Trip Shuttle
activities.description: 9AM reservation shuttle from Aspen Highlands Welcome Center. 15 min ride. At Maroon Bells by 9:15AM. Maroon Lake Scenic Loop (0.5 mi flat — perfect for all ages). Crater Lake Trail (3.6 mi RT, moderate, 500 ft gain) if energy allows. HARD STOP: Be back at lake heading to shuttle by 12:30PM.
activities.address: Maroon Bells Scenic Area, Aspen, CO 81611
tips: 9AM reservation — arrive at Aspen Highlands Welcome Center by 8:30AM
Return shuttles are first-come-first-served — last shuttle down is 5PM
Pack trail lunch from hotel — café at Bells is overpriced
Hard weather stop at 12:30PM — do not be on exposed trail after this
No swimming in Maroon Lake

flag.text: BOOK NOW at visitmaroonbells.com — Round Trip Option 1, $16/adult $10/child. Fills fast even on weekdays.

activities.via: Maroon Creek Rd → Hwy 82 to Aspen

activities.title: Lunch in Aspen — White House Tavern / NY Pizza / Big Wrap
activities.description: Pick one: White House Tavern (kale salad, chicken sandwich — upscale casual), New York Pizza (cheap, quick slices on Hyman Ave), or Big Wrap (fastest — veggie wraps, great for kids). All within 2 blocks of the gondola base.

activities.title: John Denver Sanctuary
activities.description: Free riverside park with sculptural rock installations and John Denver song lyrics embedded throughout. Open dawn to dusk. Emotional and peaceful — meaningful for the whole family. 20 min visit.

activities.title: Silver Queen Gondola — Aspen Mountain
activities.description: 18-min gondola from downtown Aspen to 11,212 ft. Panoramic views of four mountain ranges. Sundeck restaurant at top. LAST RIDE UP IS 4PM — do not be late. Family Sightseeing Package covers 2 adults + up to 4 kids.
tips: Last gondola up at 4PM — arrive by 3:45PM at latest

flag.text: Last ride up at 4PM. If arriving from Maroon Bells — must leave lake by 12:30PM to make this.

activities.title: Cooper Street Mall — Ice Cream + Walk
activities.description: Walkable pedestrian downtown. Ice cream at Paradise Bakery (unanimous local pick). Kids fountain to play in. Window shopping, galleries. Easy wind-down after the biggest day of the trip.

activities.title: Dinner Back in Glenwood — Modern Brava / Masala & Curry / The Pullman
activities.description: Drive back (~45 min) then dinner. Modern Brava Trattoria (upscale Italian, great risotto), Masala & Curry (Indian, vegetarian-friendly, highly rated), or The Pullman (New American, lively, best deviled eggs). All on Grand Ave.

days.title: Glenwood Springs Full Day — Rafting + Hot Springs

hotel.name: Glenwood Hot Springs Resort
hotel.checkIn: Check out Residence Inn by 12PM, Check into Resort
hotel.notes: Unlimited pool access included. Sopris Splash Zone for kids. Request ground floor with patio access, pool-facing side, away from elevators.

activities.title: White Water Rafting — Shoshone Rapids
activities.description: Blue Sky Adventures half-day Colorado River trip. Class III Shoshone Rapids in June (snowmelt keeps water high). Baptism, Tuttle's Tumble, Tombstone, The Wall, Maneater rapids. Wildlife: bighorn sheep, bald eagles, marmots. Done by noon. Tuesday departure is 9AM.
tips: Minimum age 5+ — your daughter is fine at 10
Apply sunscreen to TOP of legs, arms, shoulders before getting in
Life jackets provided
Book in advance — June is peak season

activities.title: Checkout Residence Inn + Lunch + Check Into Resort
activities.description: Check out by noon. Lunch nearby (Sal Mex Restaurant or Sweet Coloradough on 27th St for donuts!). Then check into Glenwood Hot Springs Resort (Conf: 1042873).

activities.title: Glenwood Hot Springs Pool
activities.description: Unlimited access included with Lodge room. No reservations needed, no time limit, hand stamp for re-entry. Sopris Splash Zone: water slides + fountains for your daughter. Grand Pool for adults. Open daily 8AM–10PM.
activities.address: 401 N River Street, Glenwood Springs, CO 81601
tips: Get to pool early to claim chairs
Hand stamp for re-entry

activities.title: Iron Mountain Hot Springs — Evening Soak
activities.description: 13-min walk from Lodge. 16 riverside mineral pools (98–108°F) alongside the Colorado River. Adults-preferred quiet zones. Genuinely relaxing — different character from the main pool. Open until 10PM.
tips: Book in advance — fills on summer evenings
13-min walk from Hot Springs Lodge

activities.title: Checkout + Drive to Red Rocks
activities.description: Pack tonight (Day 5). Checkout 7AM. Drive I-70 East to Morrison, CO (~155 mi, 2.5 hrs). Arrive Red Rocks ~10:30AM.

driveInfo.note: Optional: Independence Pass via Hwy 82 — adds 45 min, spectacular scenery. Check cotrip.org for road conditions morning of Jun 24.

activities.title: Red Rocks Park & Amphitheatre
activities.description: Free daytime entry. Trading Post Trail (1.4 mi easy loop — your daughter's easiest hike of the trip after a week of Colorado). Amphitheater walk — 192 stairs. Colorado Music Hall of Fame visitor center (7AM–7PM). Denver skyline visible on clear days. Perfect Colorado farewell.
tips: Park opens at 5AM
Visitor center 7AM–7PM
Trading Post Trail is easy — 1.4 mi loop

activities.title: Farewell Lunch — RiNo Arts District Denver
activities.description: Denver's most interesting neighborhood. Zeppelin Station food hall for casual family lunch (global cuisines, vegetarian-friendly). Or Union Station's Denver Milk Market. Out by 3PM — don't linger.

flag.text: Must leave lunch by 3PM. Return rental by 4:30PM. Be inside DEN by 5:30PM for 8:45PM flight.

activities.title: Return Rental Car at DEN
activities.description: DEN on-airport rental facility. Allow 30–45 min for return + shuttle to terminal. Be inside terminal by 5:30PM minimum.

activities.title: WN #1324 Departs DEN → STL
activities.description: 2h 10m flight. Arrive Lambert 11:55PM.
